Eight million, three hundred eighty-eight thousand, six hundred eight on the fee line — that's not a rate, that's a flag, and flags fly whichever way the wind blows. A house that can raise the rake mid-hand is a house that already knows how your hand ends.

So tell me — when the take changes between your bet and your payout, who exactly is holding the deck?
